date_note: The EFE report is dated 24 November and describes the meeting in Canberra; it gives no earlier day.
exec: Australia and Singapore say in a joint declaration that they will cooperate on AI and cybersecurity to protect digital infrastructure.
geo_basis: meeting held in Canberra, per the EFE report
plain: Australia and Singapore signed a joint declaration to work together on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.
summary: EFE reports that Australian prime minister Anthony Albanese and Singapore prime minister Lawrence Wong signed a joint declaration in Canberra. The two governments agreed to strengthen cooperation on artificial intelligence and cybersecurity to protect their digital infrastructure, and to share knowledge on assessing and certifying AI models.
title: Australia and Singapore agree to cooperate on AI and cybersecurity, EFE reports

validation.note: One EFE wire report read (via ABC Color); the governments' own declaration was not read.
